description: This file defines the PatientSearchCriteria class, which provides methods to construct database query criteria for searching Patient entities based on various parameters such as name and identifier. It includes logic for matching modes, wildcard escaping, and handling voided (deleted) entities. The class is annotated as deprecated in favor of Hibernate Search.

classes.name: PatientSearchCriteria
classes.description: A class that provides criteria construction for searching Patient entities based on name and identifier, supporting various matching modes and search options.

methods.name: prepareCriteria
methods.description: Constructs search criteria based on name, identifier, and other parameters, returning a QueryResult object with predicates and orderings.

methods.name: getSearchMode
methods.description: Determines the search mode (by name, identifier, or both) based on input parameters.
